title: Cash Pickup Reactivation Fee: Payment by the Customer's Card Authorisation
content:
## The fee charge

The fee for reactivating an expired Cash Pickup pickup is paid by the customer's own card authorisation in the app. It is paid as one reactivation fee charge, numbered with the reactivation it pays for, which is the transfer's reactivation count plus one. A fee that works out at zero is still booked, as a charge of zero.

| Transfer's reactivation count on record | Number of the reactivation the fee pays for |
|---|---|
| 0 | 1 |
| 1 | 2 |

## The tool and who runs it

The tool is `pay_reactivation_fee_6d9bfacd`, and it belongs to the customer. The agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to authorise the card payment in their own name.

## What one call does

- It collects one reactivation fee charge, dated today, on the Cash Pickup transfer's money movements, numbered with the reactivation it pays for.
- It raises the fees Paloma holds for the transfer by the amount given.

The charge then appears among the transfer's money movements and in the fees held. The pickup itself is not changed by this call.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `cash_transfer_id` | The reference number of the Cash Pickup transfer the fee is paid on, as returned by the Cash Pickup transfer lookup for this customer | identifier |
| `fee_seq` | The number of the reactivation this fee pays for: the transfer's reactivation number that the fee pays for | whole integer counting from 1 |
| `amount_usd` | The fee amount in US dollars, already rounded; it is charged exactly as given | non-negative number with 2 decimal places |

## Return

A successful call returns a receipt with these fields:
- `status`: "paid" when the charge was written;
- `ledger_entry_id`: the reference of the new fee charge;
- `fee_type`: always `reactivation_fee`;
- `fee_seq`: the reactivation number paid for;
- `amount_usd`: the amount charged, in US dollars with 2 decimals;
- `fees_held_usd`: the fees Paloma now holds for the transfer, in US dollars with 2 decimals.
